VAMPIRE PHYSIOLOGY:
The heart must be pierced by mountain ash or consecrated silver.  Decapitation ensures cessation of tissue regeneration.  Sunlight burns due to dimensional destabilization.

SANCTUARY ACCORD:
In 1848, the Council of Elders and the Holy Inquisitors signed the Treaty of the Chalice.  Neutral ground was established where hunters and vampires may drink without violence.

LOCATION:
The Crimson Chalice operates quietly in the nearby township under Lord Cassian's watchful eye.  If the Cataclysm has severed contact with our orders, that bar remains our best source of intelligence.
